product.title: Cabo San Lucas Private Yacht Cruise with Open Bar

description.text: In Cabo San Lucas, this private yacht keeps the boat for one group, with snorkeling or paddleboarding at Pelican Rock and Chileno Bay plus a pass at the Arch of Cabo San Lucas. Drinks and snacks are included so the outing stays on the water rather than a marina restaurant stop. The meeting point is Local A at Tesoro Hotel on Blvd. Paseo de la Marina. The private format is aimed at visitors who want a guided scenic charter without sharing the deck with another party. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cabo San Lucas, and the itinerary stays on Pelican Rock, the Arch, and Chileno Bay that define this yacht day rather than a shared sunset sail or glass-bottom city loop.

highlights: Explore the Cabo waters in style—in the company of just your friends or family—on this private yacht cruise
